attach smd: SMD attach: via or trace anchored to the center of a surface-mount pad
bend cost: bend cost (penalty when a trace changes direction on a layer)
clearance: clearance (minimum distance between copper or mechanical features)
clearance matrix: clearance matrix (spacing table between item classes)
conduction area: conduction area (copper pour/plane tied to one net)
courtyard: courtyard (minimum keepout around a component body)
DSN: DSN file (Specctra design format; often kept as DSN)
fanout: fanout (escape routing from dense pads, e.g. BGA)
gate: gate (Specctra logical pin group within a component)
gate pin: gate pin (Specctra pin reference through a gate)
keepout: keepout (zone where routing or placement is forbidden)
layer: layer (copper, mask, silkscreen, or documentation plane)
logical part: logical part (Specctra component definition before placement)
neckdown: neckdown (automatic trace width reduction at a pad)
net class: net class (shared routing rules for a set of nets)
obstacle area: obstacle area (copper/mechanical area that blocks routing)
padstack: padstack (pad and drill pattern for a pin or via)
power plane: power plane (copper pour for power or ground)
preferred direction: preferred direction (horizontal/vertical routing bias per layer)
pull tight: pull tight (straighten and optimize trace geometry)
push and shove: push & shove (interactive routing that displaces existing traces)
SES: SES file (Specctra session with routing results)
shove fixed: shove fixed (net cannot be displaced by push/shove)
signal layer: signal layer (copper layer used for trace routing)
stitch mode: stitch mode (routing mode for shove-fixed nets)
terminal item: terminal item (route endpoint: pin, via, or area)
unroute: unroute (remove routing from items or nets)
unrouted: unrouted (not yet connected by finished copper)
via keepout: via keepout (zone where vias are forbidden)
via rule: via rule (allowed via padstacks and layer spans for a net class)
